statement: A dimension-minimal cubic-homogeneous collision algebra is generated by its collision midpoint and difference, has d in A^3 and dim A/A^3 at most one, every nonzero proper ideal contains d, its minimal ideal D has nonzero internal cubic product, and dim D is at least ceil((n-1)/2).
title: Dimension-Minimal Cubic Collision Algebras Are Monolithic
